title: One Active Alignment Holding per Vehicle — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
A vehicle may carry only one active alignment service or plan at a time. This is the per-vehicle rule of Alignment Services & Plans: holdings are aggregated per vehicle, and the cap is 1 active holding per vehicle on every line.

### What decides it

- **Evidence.** The system record of the alignment holdings on the vehicle and their status decides the question, before a new holding is sold for that vehicle. Holdings are correlated to the vehicle the new holding is to be sold for; a holding on another vehicle of the same customer does not count.
- **What counts.** Only a holding in status active counts. A holding that has expired, been cancelled or ended because the purchaser no longer owns the vehicle does not.

### Moving to a longer plan

A customer who wants to move from a single service or a shorter plan to a longer one while the first is active buys the new plan only after the first has expired or been cancelled. A single service still inside its readjustment guarantee is not cancellable and runs to its expiration date.

### Judgement table (hypothetical vehicles)

| Holdings already on the vehicle | Another holding sold for it now? |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| One holding in status active | No |
| One expired holding only | Yes |
| One cancelled holding only | Yes |
| An active holding on a different vehicle of the same customer | Yes — it is not on this vehicle |
